key_point: Pokemon GO started as a joke
title: Pokemon GO started as a joke
caption: Pokemon GO grew out of a 2014 Google Maps April Fools prank. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #pokemongo #pokemon

instagram.caption:
On April 1, 2014, Google Maps posted a prank: a job opening for a Pokemon Master, with Pokemon hidden on the real map.

Niantic's John Hanke and The Pokemon Company saw how much people loved it and turned the joke into a real game.

In 2016 Pokemon GO launched and got millions of people outside, walking through their cities looking for Pikachu.

Where was your best Pokemon GO catch?
